nativeRoute: QA Tools platform API key first; Micro App Feishu JWT fallback

loginFlow.steps: 复用 QA_TOOLS_TOKEN → password store qatools.staging-api-key → qatools.staging；缺失时管理员在 /api-keys 创建/refresh 30 天 key。JWT 仅无 key 或用户选择时由用户在 Micro App qa-tools-staging 入口登录并本机安全保存，不程序化 SSO。
loginFlow.authorization: Login, token creation/rotation/revocation and business writes require the current task scope; this discovery performs none.

tokenMechanism: Bearer qatools_ API key 或 SSO JWT；key 30 天，JWT 数小时；不得静默降级凭据类型。
subjectPermission: 源码 apiKeyAuth/auth 中绑定 key owner 或 JWT user；健康检查不证明 identity。需补部署已支持的只读 identity/permission probe，业务 mutation 不作认证试验。
expiryRevoke: API_KEY_INVALID/EXPIRED/REVOKED 停止交管理员更新；refresh key 会撤销旧 key；JWT expiry 由用户重新获取。

versionPolicy.rule: Candidate source and published contracts do not establish deployed compatibility. Verify the target instance version and read-only supported capabilities before enabling an adapter.

verification.scope: Read-only documentation/repository discovery; no login, token issuance, credential inspection or business API execution.
